Fit a BGAM or reuse an existing brms model

Source: R/fit_or_reuse_bgam.R
fit_or_reuse_bgam.Rd

Centralizes the brms fitting arguments and the `previous_model` path. This helper does not validate model/data compatibility, construct prediction grids, or compute any posterior quantities; callers retain those duties.

Usage

fit_or_reuse_bgam(
  formula,
  data,
  family,
  previous_model = NULL,
  n_post_samples = NULL,
  warmup = 1000,
  iter = 2000,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  threads = NULL,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  stan_control = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  stan_model_args = NULL,
  extra_args = list(),
  resolve_draws = TRUE,
  reuse_message = "Using `previous_model`: skipping model fitting.",
  fit_fun = brms::brm,
  ndraws_fun = brms::ndraws
)

Arguments

formula

A brms model formula.

data

The model data frame.

family

A brms family.

previous_model

Optional existing `brmsfit`.

n_post_samples

Optional requested number of posterior draws.

warmup, iter, chains, cores, threads

Sampling settings.

backend

Backend used by brms.

stan_control

Sampling control options forwarded as `control`.

file

Optional model cache filename.

stan_model_args

Optional Stan compilation options. If NULL, uses `stanc_options = list("O1")` for cmdstanr, and an empty list for rstan.

extra_args

Named or unnamed arguments forwarded to `brms::brm()`.

resolve_draws

Whether to populate `n_post_samples` from the model if the caller supplied NULL. Set FALSE when draw selection is handled separately by the caller.

reuse_message

Message printed if an existing fit is reused.

fit_fun, ndraws_fun

Callable dependencies; injectable for fast tests.

Value

A list containing `model`, `n_post_samples`, and `reused`.
